definition_from_official_metadata: Site ID. Sites with prefix N or P are non-icy or possible/probable exposures. Some site IDs are absent because observations were reclassified into a different category and the number was not reused.
Icy status. “Yes (CTX)” means that a crater is interpreted as icy based on bright pixels in CTX but lacks HiRISE color confirmation.
Diameters of all ice-exposing craters; “x” if none. If several, the diameters are separated by a semicolon.
Diameters of the largest one or several ice-free craters; “x” if none. If several, the diameters are separated by a semicolon.

CRISM H2O ice detection status (possible/confirmed craters only). “y” if CRISM shows an ice signal, “n” if there is no ice spectral signature, and “x” if there is no appropriate data (full-resolution observations with high-quality near-infrared data).
